T:P1.3.text: Pangaea is a global provider of comprehensive maritime logistics and transportation solutions. The Company addresses the logistics needs of its clients by undertaking a comprehensive set of services and activities. We not only own and operate a large fleet of bulk carriers, including high ice class vessels but we design, produce and operate port and inland projects.

T:P1.5.text: No two projects are the same. We customize each project based on our client's specific needs. Our attention to detail is critical in forming lasting relationships. If you have a need, we will find a solution.

T:P1.6.text: Almost 50% of our owned fleet is made up of Ice Class 1A vessels. We have pioneered both the Northern Sea Route and the Northwest Passage resulting in lower CO2 emissions, fewer days at sea and substantial fuel savings.

T:P1.8.text: We have expertise in the development and expansion of port facilities; specifically loading and discharging operations. We recently completed a loading port in Newfoundland and the expansion of a port terminal in Charleston, S.C.

T:P1.10.text: We have extensive experience in handling cargoes like DRI A, B & C. We educate and train our crew to avoid any issues while carrying these complex cargoes. SAFETY is always our #1 priority.

T:P2.3.text: Pangaea is a US-based maritime logistics and transportation company utilizing its expertise to service a broad base of customers who require the transportation of a wide variety of dry bulk cargoes. The Company addresses the logistics needs of its customers by undertaking a comprehensive set of services and activities that seeks to add value at every step of the supply chain.

T:P2.4.text: The Company operates a fleet of approximately 45-60 Supramax, Panamax and Handymax vessels, of which 40 are owned or partially owned. The Company is a leader in the high ice class sector, secured by its control of a majority of the world’s large dry bulk vessels with Ice-Class 1a designation.

C:P1.1.text: Heartland Express - We’re giving truck drivers the best pay, the best trucks, and the best experience.

C:P1.2.text: Heartland Express drivers are key to the success of our company. Our drivers are known to be some of the best in the business so we offer the most attractive driving positions, backed by a commitment to safety and better driver CSA scores, a commitment to keeping drivers busy and productive, a commitment to meeting home-time schedules, and the very best pay available.

C:P1.3.text: “Service for Success” is what we stand for

C:P1.4.text: Heartland Express is known for the best in class service to our customers. This comes from having the best drivers, equipment, and technology to offer the best. Service for Success is who we are, it’s what we’re all about.

C:P2.2.text: Delivering exceptional results to our customers.

C:P2.3.text: Heartland Express customers represent the most successful businesses in the world. The top shippers in America depend on Heartland Express to improve business performance, deliver exceptional results to their customers, and drive overall value into their transportation supply chain.

C:P2.4.text: As the performance needs of our shippers increase, Heartland Express has even more opportunity to differentiate our service and demonstrate the strength that our company was built on. FedEx and other top shippers have recently awarded Heartland as their carrier of the year.

C:P2.5.text: Another consistent contributor to the economy, we appreciate the opportunity to serve our customers in the consumer goods space. Unilever and other leaders in the consumer goods market have recently awarded Heartland Express as their best-in-class performer.

C:P2.6.text: As an essential and consistent segment of the American economy, food distribution makes up a substantial portion of the customers we serve. Heartland Express has been honored to accept performance awards recently from Quaker Oats, Gatorade, Kellogg Company, Nestle Waters, and many more.

C:P2.7.text: Heartland Express serves the supply chain needs of many manufacturers in America, including supply operations, DC transfers, and vendor deliveries. As supply-to-cash cycles get shorter and faster in the JIT environment, Heartland has excelled in meeting difficult requirements. Whirlpool and other leading producers have recently recognized Heartland Express as their supplier of the year.

C:P2.8.text: We serve many shippers that manufacturer and supply paper, plastic, and packaging products. Cups, bowls, plates, containers, napkins, tissues, home and office paper - some of the many products that our drivers protect and deliver every day.

C:P2.9.text: Heartland Express excels at time-sensitive store replenishment, and has recently won performance awards from Sears, Walmart, Lowes, and many more. We value this business and the strategic relationships that we have developed to execute for the retailers that we serve.

C:P2.10.text: Measure our performance against our peers in these key value drivers and demonstrate Heartland's capability to increase customer satisfaction in your business. Learn More >
